title: Your First BYOB Boat
why: Warm-ish planners who found the boat and need the practical 'how does BYOB actually work' answers before they book. Answers drinks, music, weather.
hook_options: Nothing's served on board. That's the point.
3 things to know before your first BYOB boat
Who's on aux? And other BYOB boat questions
caption: First BYOB boat? Bring every drink you want, pick one phone for the Bluetooth, and don't sweat the drizzle. The boats are covered and only lightning cancels. And yes, there's a bathroom on board. Save this for the group chat. #neworleans #nola #byob #bachelorette #bayou

slides.headline: Nothing's served on board. That's the point.
Drinks, music, weather. In that order.
slides.body: Get these three right and the captain handles the rest.

slides.headline: Bring everything you want to drink
Your cooler, your bar, no tab
slides.body: No drink minimums, no $14 margaritas. There's a bar setup on board to stock. Snacks and food are fine too.

slides.headline: Bluetooth sound. Your playlist.
slides.body: Pick one phone, build the playlist at the hotel, and charge it. Dead-battery silence on a party boat is brutal.

slides.headline: Covered boats. Only lightning cancels.
slides.body: Rain doesn't cancel a trip. There's a roof over the deck, and the boats are heated in winter.

slides.headline: Pack the cooler. Charge the phone. Relax.
slides.body: Oh, and there's a bathroom on board. You'll thank us around minute 50.

slides.kicker: Save this for the group chat
slides.headline: Bring the drinks. We'll bring the boat.
slides.body: 1 hour 45 on Bayou Bienvenue, 7 miles from the Quarter. nolapartybarges.com
